name: WESTMINSTER
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of My God, How Wonderful Thou Art (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/My_God_How_Wonderful_Thou_Art/, My_God_How_Wonderful_Thou_Art.xml, whose rights line reads “MUSIC: “Westminster”; James Turle, 1835. Public Domain.”); only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 35511 76553 71255 (https://hymnary.org/tune/westminster_turle). This is Turle's WESTMINSTER, not WESTMINSTER ABBEY. No hand fixes. Turle's dates (1802–1882) and the year 1835 are from the hymnary.org tune page (Timeless Truths also gives 1835).
